open_questions: g_0828717f and g_08287180 (size-class tables used by MT_GetSize) lie in .bss; the chunk does not initialise them. Locate the writer (likely an init in another chunk) to confirm the table contents.
Callers push a second stack argument to MT_AllocIndex, StrPool_AllocBlock and ScrStr_Intern that MT_AllocIndex never reads. Confirm this is ABI residue in all callers (no semantic argument).

ScrStr_Intern flag-0 bucket branch uses the bucket handle (a 16-bit MT handle) as a node index into sl_hash[0x4000]; handles above 0x3fff would index out of range. Original behaviour preserved; confirm with a runtime trace whether this path is reachable.
ScrStr_FreeNode and ScrStr_Intern write sl_last_link_ptr only in one branch (0x08297404); confirm no reader exists in other chunks.
ScrDbg_LineValue and ScrDbg_GetFileAndLine dereference the floor file entry without a NULL check; preserved crash path, confirm callers never pass a key below the first file key.

Naming for ScrStr_*/ScrDbg_*/ScrRuntime_* follows the IW-style SL_/Scr_ families by role; no direct symbol strings name these functions, so they are inferred. The merge lane should confirm against sibling chunks.

Out-of-chunk callees fn_08060dea, fn_08061124, fn_080b7fa6, fn_080b7f0a, fn_08060c20 are printf-like console/error helpers; their exact signatures (and that fn_08061124 does not return) are inferred from call shape.
Some void-declared decompiler functions end with a callee whose EAX value is consumed (ScrStr_HandleOfText, fn_0807a0a8 hook path); only the consumed cases are reproduced as int returns.
